text: On a family outing to a large rocky hill, [where a dying killer once vanished|origin|places with dark pasts], the adolescent siblings Adolfo and Sara [enter a cave and do not return|threat|evil places]. Police find them the next morning after an unusual earthquake, but at home they behave strangely, and a doctor raises the possibility of abuse. Their parents Felix and Sol [kill a local man they suspect|wrong|a life taken], while a gas station attendant insists the hill is cursed and Sol follows her children back toward [the mouth of the cave|images|wild and lonely places].
